summary.en: Character set transcoding package for converting between legacy encodings and UTF-8/Unicode.
summary.zh: 用于在传统字符编码与 UTF-8/Unicode 之间做转码的字符集转换包。

en: The official Windows override links against the bundled `win-iconv` shared library so the same `iconv` API can be used cross-platform.
zh: 官方 Windows override 会链接随 bundle 提供的 `win-iconv` 共享库，以便跨平台复用同一套 `iconv` API。
